SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countries;
SELECT * FROM countries WHERE region = 'South Asia';
SELECT capital_city FROM countries WHERE iso3 = 'JAPAN';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countries WHERE income_group = 'Low income';
SELECT population FROM country_stats WHERE iso3 = 'India' AND year = 2023;

SELECT name, population
FROM countries
WHERE year = 2023
ORDER BY population DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT income_group, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
GROUP BY income_group;

SELECT iso3, gdp_per_capita_usd FROM countries
WHERE year = 2023
ORDER BY gdp_per_capita_usd DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT year, population, gdp_usd, gdp_per_capita_usd, life_expectancy_years, fertility_rate, urban_population_pct, internet_users_pct, unemployment_pct
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
ORDER BY year;
SELECT * FROM countries WHERE region = 'Sub-Saharan Africa' AND life_expectancy_years > 70;

SELECT country_stats.iso3, country_stats.year, country_stats.population, country_stats.gdp_usd, country_stats.gdp_per_capita_usd, country_stats.life_expectancy_years, country_stats.fertility_rate, country_stats.urban_population_pct, country_stats.internet_users_pct, country_stats.unemployment_pct
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE countries.iso3 = 'DE'
AND country_stats.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2023
ORDER BY country_stats.year;

SELECT region, fertility_rate
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE year = 2023
GROUP BY region;

SELECT countries.iso3, country_stats.fertility_rate
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE countries.region = 'Europe & Central Asia'
AND country_stats.year = 2023
ORDER BY country_stats.fertility_rate ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT year, gdp_usd FROM country_stats WHERE iso3 = 'US' AND year IN (2000, 2023);

SELECT region, internet_users_pct
FROM countries
WHERE year = 2023
AND internet_users_pct > 70
ORDER BY region ASC;
SELECT population * 100 AS percentage_increase FROM country_stats WHERE iso3 = 'CHN' AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2023;

SELECT name, life_expectancy_years - life_expectancy_years_2000 AS gain
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2023
ORDER BY gain DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT income_group, gdp_usd
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE year = 2023
ORDER BY gdp_usd DESC;

SELECT countries.iso3, country_stats.gdp_per_capita_usd
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE country_stats.gdp_per_capita_usd > (SELECT AVG(gdp_per_capita_usd) FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023) AND country_stats.year = 2023;

SELECT population * life_expectancy_years / (population + life_expectancy_years + 1) * 100 AS population_weighted_avg_life_expectancy
FROM country_stats
WHERE iso3 = 'World'
AND year = 2023;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countries WHERE year = 2023 AND population < population FROM countries WHERE year = 2010;

SELECT name, region, life_expectancy_years
FROM countries
WHERE year = 2023
AND life_expectancy_years < 60
ORDER BY name;

SELECT region, (population * 100) / (population + (population * 100)) AS percentage
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE year = 2023
ORDER BY region;

SELECT countries.iso3, country_stats.gdp_usd
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE country_stats.year = 2023
AND country_stats.gdp_usd IS NULL;

SELECT country_stats.iso3, country_stats.year, country_stats.population, country_stats.gdp_usd, country_stats.gdp_per_capita_usd, country_stats.life_expectancy_years, country_stats.fertility_rate, country_stats.urban_population_pct, country_stats.internet_users_pct, country_stats.unemployment_pct
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE countries.name = 'France'

SELECT region, 
       (CASE WHEN population = 0 THEN 0 ELSE population END) AS population_median,
       (CASE WHEN population = 0 THEN 0 ELSE population END) AS population_median
FROM countries
WHERE region IN ('Europe & Central Asia', 'Sub-Saharan Africa')
AND year = 2023
ORDER BY population DESC, population ASC;

SELECT iso3
FROM countries
WHERE iso3 IN (
    SELECT iso3
    FROM country_stats
    WHERE year = 2010 AND internet_users_pct < 10
    AND iso3 IN (
        SELECT iso3
        FROM country_stats
        WHERE year = 2023 AND internet_users_pct > 50
    )
)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE species = 'Gentoo';
SELECT island FROM penguins;
SELECT body_mass_g FROM penguins ORDER BY body_mass_g DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE sex IS NULL;
SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins;
SELECT species, COUNT(*) AS count FROM penguins GROUP BY species;

SELECT island, year, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM penguins
GROUP BY island, year
SELECT AVG(bill_length_mm) FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'male' AND bill_length_mm IS NOT NULL;

SELECT species, AVG(flipper_length_mm) AS average_flipper_length
FROM penguins
GROUP BY species
ORDER BY average_flipper_length DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT island, COUNT(*) AS num_penguins
FROM penguins
GROUP BY island
ORDER BY num_penguins DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT species, sex, body_mass_g
FROM penguins
WHERE sex IN ('male', 'female')
GROUP BY species, sex
HAVING body_mass_g IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY species, sex;

SELECT species, (SELECT AVG(body_mass_g) - (SELECT AVG(body_mass_g)) AS gap FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'male') AS gap
FROM penguins
WHERE sex IN ('male', 'female')
ORDER BY gap DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE body_mass_g > (SELECT AVG(body_mass_g) FROM penguins) AND species != 'male' AND species != 'female';
SELECT percentage FROM penguins WHERE island = 'Biscoe' AND species = 'Gentoo';

SELECT species, year, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM penguins
GROUP BY species, year
ORDER BY species, year;
SELECT island FROM penguins GROUP BY island HAVING COUNT(species) > 1;

SELECT species, island, body_mass
FROM penguins
WHERE bill_length_mm > (SELECT MAX(bill_length_mm) FROM penguins)
ORDER BY species, island;

SELECT species, (bill_length_mm + bill_depth_mm + flipper_length_mm + body_mass_g) / 2 AS average_mass
FROM penguins
WHERE year = 2007
GROUP BY species
ORDER BY species;

SELECT species, island
FROM penguins
WHERE (flipper_length_mm / (SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins)) > (SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins)
